name: aspirational-roadmapping
description: Use when the user asks about strategic or technology roadmapping, multi-year roadmaps, aligning a roadmap with OKRs, RICE, WSJF or MoSCoW prioritization, dependency maps or roadmap reviews with executives. Produces an outcome-based strategic roadmap. Not for a quarterly feature roadmap (use planning-create-roadmap) or sprint planning (use pm).
